package org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect.type;

import java.lang.reflect.Type;

import org.apache.commons.lang3.reflect.type.TypeLiteral;

/**
 * Generalization of "has a type."
 *
 * @param <T> The type
 * @see TypeLiteral
 * @since 3.2
 */
@FunctionalInterface
public interface Typed<T> {

    /**
     * Gets the {@link Type} represented by this entity.
     *
     * @return Type
     */
    Type getType();
}
